race.comment: ONAVUITTON (7) raced wide throughout when resuming here two weeks ago but never gave in and kept coming. Will appreciate the extra 200m second-up and with a softer run in transit he can play a major role. REGAL MIGHT (3) got the bob last start at Bendigo when leading pillar-to-post, and was unlucky not to score the start prior when missing by neck. Not a heap tougher this time and Kennedy's 2kg claim helps. Can give another sight. LYRICS 'N' SONG (11) was less effective last time at Geelong but did have some excuses. Expecting her to be at her top now, and with even luck she can play a role. DISCOVER LUPINO (15) got off the mark in style when rounding them up at Geelong. Drawn to settle closer here and while this is obviously tougher, he can play a role.
